honesty.legacy: When source is legacy_latency_s, end-to-end is 1000 * latency_s for that (query, model). TTFT/queue/generation are unavailable. Router overhead is missing unless a router_decision_ms span was measured.
honesty.overhead: router_overhead_ms is the measured router_decision span, not end_to_end minus the selected model's API time (that residual would mix clock error with unmeasured queueing).
